# Mantra Meridian Riverside, Balewadi, Pune

> Official comprehensive factual monograph and project specifications for Mantra Meridian Riverside (also known as Meridian at Riverside), an 8-acre luxury residential development in Balewadi, Pune, developed by Mantra Properties.

## Project Summary
- **Official Name**: Mantra Meridian Riverside
- **Alternate Names**: Meridian at Riverside, Mantra Meridian Balewadi, Meridian Balewadi
- **Developer**: Mantra Properties (17+ years legacy, 50+ delivered & ongoing projects)
- **MahaRERA Registration Number**: P52100045688
- **Official MahaRERA Verification**: https://maharera.mahaonline.gov.in/
- **Project Location**: Sr. No. 45, 13, Balewadi Village Road, near Mamta Dining Hall, Balewadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411045
- **Verified Google Maps Listing**: [Site - Mantra Riverside](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Site+-+Mantra+Riverside/@18.5839181,73.7747366,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x3bc2b90046a5808b:0xd7087df3d2222d59!8m2!3d18.5839181!4d73.7747366!16s%2Fg%2F11x7zq3s0c) (Google CID: 15494874017770876249, KG ID: /g/11x7zq3s0c)
- **Exact Geo Coordinates**: 18.5839181° N, 73.7747366° E
- **Total Development Area**: 8 Acres
- **Open Space**: Over 75% landscaped open green area
- **Frontage**: 500-metre riverfront promenade along the Mula River
- **Target Possession / Handover**: June 2028 (MahaRERA sanctioned completion)

## Living Configurations & Carpet Areas
1. **2 BHK Luxury Residences (The Urban Canvas)**
   - Carpet Area: 785 sq.ft. – 845 sq.ft.
   - Bathrooms: 2 Luxury Baths
   - Indicative Starting Price: ₹ 85 Lakhs* onwards
   - Orientation: Riparian river-breeze balcony, optimal cross-ventilation

2. **3 BHK Signature Residences (The Meridian Signature)**
   - Carpet Area: 1,120 sq.ft. – 1,240 sq.ft.
   - Bathrooms: 3 Luxury Baths
   - Indicative Starting Price: ₹ 1.28 Cr* onwards
   - Orientation: Wraparound corner deck with uninterrupted Mula river views

3. **3 BHK Signature Sky Duplexes (The Two-Tier Sky Home)**
   - Carpet Area: 1,580 sq.ft. – 1,740 sq.ft.
   - Levels: Two Tiers (Double-Height 20ft Living Salon)
   - Bathrooms: 3 Luxury Baths + Powder Room
   - Indicative Starting Price: ₹ 1.85 Cr* onwards
   - Orientation: Expansive double-height terrace deck, internal architectural staircase

4. **4 BHK Grand Estates (The Riverfront Villa in the Sky)**
   - Carpet Area: 1,920 sq.ft. – 2,180 sq.ft.
   - Bathrooms: 4 Luxury En-suite Baths + Powder Room
   - Indicative Starting Price: ₹ 2.40 Cr* onwards
   - Orientation: Dual master suites, private elevator foyer, panoramic riparian views

- 20,000 sq.ft. Central Clubhouse ("The Grand Pavilion")

## Connectivity & Infrastructure Catalysts
- **Balewadi High Street**: 5 minutes (fine dining, Grade-A commercial tech parks)
- **Proposed Mula River Bridge**: Directly connects Balewadi Village Road across the river to Wakad in under 5 minutes
- **Pune Metro Line 3**: 3-4 minutes to elevated Balewadi & Baner Metro Stations (connecting Hinjewadi to Shivajinagar)
- **Hinjewadi IT Park (Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park)**: 12-15 minutes via Wakad bypass / upcoming bridge
- **Baner Commercial CBD**: 8 minutes
- **Jupiter & Manipal Hospitals**: 7-10 minutes
- **Premier Schools**: The Orchid School, Bharati Vidyapeeth, MITCON International (within 5-10 minutes)
- **Pune Airport (PNQ)**: 45 minutes via Western Bypass & Ring Road
- **Mumbai-Pune Expressway**: 15 minutes
